The accepted reading holds. frame_layers does not play through a hold (lane test and q3). Razor, trim, slip, lift range, extract range, close gap carry the record and undo exactly (q4; nest, subsequence, rate planners in the lane tests). Insert frame hold segment: whole clip, left edge, right edge, middle, one frame: nothing moves, frame count stays, one held piece at the span, undo exact; off-clip spans refused (q5). deviations_from_brief.item: Items 1 and hostile input: Folio does NOT refuse a hold outside the clip's source window.
deviations_from_brief.why: Item 1 requires razor and clones to carry the hold. A razor of a held clip leaves one piece whose window does not hold the frame, and a trim or slip can do the same, and both must keep showing it. A window check in validate_sequences would make every razor of a held clip folio_rejected.
deviations_from_brief.instead: The planners refuse it when the frame is chosen (frame_hold_outside_source_window); resolve_source_frames and clip_source_at refuse a stored hold at or past a KNOWN source length (past_source_end). Folio refuses a hold on a non-video track and at the last representable tick. With an unknown source length a hand-edited hold outside the window loads and resolves. Tests a_hold_outside_the_window_of_a_cut_piece_loads, edits_carry_the_retime_record, hold_refusals_are_typed.

declared_readings: UNVERIFIED (D5), accepted by the lead: Folio does NOT refuse a frame hold outside the clip's source window, because razor and trim pieces must keep the frame. Planners refuse it when set (frame_hold_outside_source_window); reads refuse a hold at or past a KNOWN source length (past_source_end). A hand-edited hold outside the window, with an UNKNOWN source length, loads and resolves to that frame.

UNVERIFIED (D5), spec silent: AUDIO OF A HELD CLIP. A frame hold freezes the picture only. A clip on a non-video track cannot be held (frame_hold_not_video; Folio invalid_field). A linked audio partner keeps playing its own window through the held span; insert frame hold segment cuts it at the same ticks so each link group stays one clip per track.

UNVERIFIED (D5), spec silent: the held frame is resolved once and stored as the first tick of that frame. In point and out point do not follow later trims or slips; razor pieces keep it even when their window no longer holds it.

UNVERIFIED (D5), spec silent: the OUT POINT frame. source_out is exclusive, so the frame is the last one starting before source_out (130 F exactly gives frame 129; 129 F + 1 tick also gives 129). MT-33732's proof text asks an ambiguous out-point selection to refuse and forbids a silent guess: this is a stated rule instead, with a spec proposal.
UNVERIFIED (D5), spec silent: in point and out point are the clip's source bounds whatever the sign of the speed.
UNVERIFIED (D5), spec silent: the playhead picks the frame frame_sampling shows there, whatever the clip's interpolation choice.
UNVERIFIED (D5), spec silent: a hold and the retime options apply to the named clip, not its link group.

UNVERIFIED (D5): insert frame hold segment holds a span of the clip in place. Nothing moves, the outer pieces keep their windows and the frame count stays; the first piece keeps the clip id. MT-33732's oracle says 'split plan preserves outer windows and frame count'. Premiere's command may insert time instead.
UNVERIFIED (D5): frame_sampling's nearest frame takes a tie to the later source frame, in both directions.
UNVERIFIED (D5): reversed position is L - offset * |speed| with L the start of the last frame of the window, so the head shows the last frame and unit reverse mirrors forward.
UNVERIFIED (D5): only frames of the source window are named. A position past the last frame, or below the first when reversed, stays on it with weight 0; handles are not read.
UNVERIFIED (D5): defaults when a clip states nothing are frame_sampling and maintain_audio_pitch false.
A held clip answers Held at every interpolation choice and carries no estimation mark: it is one real source frame.

A hold on a multicam clip or a clip of a multicam source sequence is refused frame_hold_multicam when the caller passes the records (None skips the check, as rate.rs does); clearing a hold stays open.

UNVERIFIED (D5): multicam reads no hold. A hold on a clip multicam would read is refused multicam_hold_unsupported in resolve, flatten, create and enable; switch, the other toggles and a record pass do not read a frame and are not refused. Turning a mode off and clearing the hold stay open.

STU-VID-031a: state that a held frame may lie outside a cut piece's window, and whether insert frame hold segment inserts time or holds a span in place. Proposed: it may, and in place.
